relations.subject: Julius Lipner

relations.subject: Julius Lipner

relations.subject: Julius Lipner
relations.role: Professor of Hinduism and the Comparative Study of Religion
relations.evidence: before being appointed to Cambridge University in 1975, from where he retired as Professor of Hinduism and the Comparative Study of Religion at the end of 2013.

relations.subject: Julius Lipner
relations.evidence: Lipner is a Fellow Emeritus and former Vice-President of Clare Hall, a postgraduate College of the University of Cambridge.
